newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey looks at audio and tv operations.
newsitem.headline: Plessey looks at audio and tv operations.

text.p: South Africa's Plessey Corp said on Wednesday that it was reconsidering its position in the audio and television consumer electronics sectors.
The firm, which on Monday issued a cautionary announcement, said in a statement that contrary to some market expectations, no further news was expected in the short-term.
Plessey said its options included restructuring its consumer goods operations and so staying in the market or readjusting its Telefunken partnership with France's Thomson Multimedia.
Another option, the firm added, was to sell off its consumer electroncis business as a whole. Plessey said there were five possible bidders for the unit.
"Exploring these options in the best interest of all shareholders would take some time and an announcement would follow in due course," the firm said.
